edits.anchor: \noindent Language models are entering systematic-review workflows, but most evaluations use cloud models, cannot separate reading from training-data recall, and treat the human answer key as infallible. EXTRAI is a pre-registered, five-phase benchmark of five quantized open-weight models (8--14.8B parameters, one consumer mini-PC, integrated GPU, no cloud calls) --- plus a 27B mixed-precision build, measured at 3.13 bits per weight, added afterwards as a pre-registered extension arm --- as meta-analysis workers over two published meta-analyses and their 21 trials, under two controls: a \emph{perturbation reading proof} (load-bearing numbers displaced under sealed maps, making recitation detectable) and a \emph{two-layer, source-verified answer key} whose quotation-backed rite puts the human key itself on trial, documenting eleven source-confirmed discrepancies in one anchor and correcting its own cells twice. Reading: 168 perturbed sheets, zero attributable recitations, zero invention candidates, replicate stability 77--99\%. Arithmetic: 1 of 73 unaided confidence intervals exact, rising to 86\% through a trivial text-protocol calculator; pooling stayed out of reach for the 8--14.8B cast and was closed, 12 of 12, only by the 27B extension arm. Creation: \emph{all six} models' sheets reproduced the published dichotomous pools (morbidity 0.771--0.787 vs.\ 0.778), while the continuous diamond separated them --- in the cast exactly one model, \texttt{gemma4:12b}, landed beside the published $-0.24$, at $-0.27$, the rest at $-0.47$ to $-0.80$, and the extension arm landed closer still, at $-0.25$ $[-0.33, -0.16]$ --- never through arithmetic and never through fabrication --- the invention screen found none. Orchestration: under a warn-only ten-net harness, confirm-or-correct resolved every warning and the model's pooling call closed digit-consistent with its executed results. Deployment, on clean texts with no answer key: the model sided with the sources at all seven discrepancies reaching a single extractable cell, its one failed tolerance decomposed to one mislabeled-dispersion cell, and conversational and sheet-level nets proved complements, not substitutes. An instruction-language robustness check (instruments drafted in Portuguese, frozen in English, identical materials) found every phase within replicate-level variance and the flagship diamond identical in both ($-0.27$ $[-0.38, -0.17]$): no conclusion is an artifact of instruction language. All protocols, seals, sheets and raw outputs are public.
